Overview

Changsha is a city in Hunan with a population of 10,047,000. Capital of Hunan province, known for its spicy cuisine, vibrant entertainment industry, and the hometown of Mao Zedong. Housing is notably more expensive than the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
